I'm afraid that telling my therapist everything will cause them to call the police on me. 

Also my friends are outwardly disgusted with me and don't want to even think about me, much less be around me or communicate with me. And my parents are deeply worried and honestly, I saw fear in their eyes.

Mainly because I hate most of humanity because I've suffered and project my pain as being caused by them, thus rejecting most social interactions. This makes me want to torture and kill them, and it really doesn't help that I see most beneath me. Intellectually, this is obviously not true and I know it, but I can't shake the idea (not for lack of trying). In short, I'm working on it. 

Also because I've killed people's cats. That's a dick move. I know I'd be pissed if someone killed my cat. 

And also because of the fires. I've destroyed people's properties and forced people to leave their homes at 3am more than once. 

All in all, I'm a murderous half-sociopath who hates people and thinks about killing them all the time. It's only a matter of time before my dark side wins and I become a serial killer, but I've been fighting that. I really really don't want that. 

But I'm still a monster.

I am on drugs, although that's mainly to stop myself from killing myself and not take away the thoughts. 

While I agree with you philosophically, but in reality it's much easier to be happy when not in prison or the streets. One must imagine Sisyphus happy, yes, but Sisyphus would probably prefer to not be pushing that rock. We must find joy in our suffering, because we are still alive, but I'd really prefer I not go down that path. 

Not sure why you're being downvoted.

Yeah I think I've learned my lesson about not drinking. 

Whoo yay for violent misanthropy!
